Name: Glory Of Efficiency
Author: Waxhell
Description:
[size=4][b][u]Glory Of Efficiency[/u][/b] is a configurable utility-set mod which can help the gameplay be more efficient and less redundant.  It tries to be balanced, but allows customization into the "cheaty" levels if desired. 

This mod is a direct decendent of Punyo's most excellent "Joys Of Efficiency" mod which appears to not be maintained any more.  Glory Of Efficiency is forked from JoE under the GPL v3.0.  If Punyo ever wishes to return to maintaining their mod, this mod will send push changes to the original author and be discontinued.

[OVERALL]
[/size][size=4]The settings can be changed through the config.json, which should be created after the first run.  ﻿Or you can change the configurations via the in-game settings menu by pressing [i]KeyShowMenu[/i] (Default:R key).

﻿This mod works on client side completely. (You don't have to be a host to take effect)[/size][size=4]

[BUG REPORTING]
Bug reports should be posted to the [url=https://github.com/Hackswell/GloryOfEfficiency/issues]﻿GitHub issues page[/url]﻿ if possible. Please include the Stardew Valley game version, SMAPI version, and Glory Of Efficiency version. And any ﻿logs if you have them![/size]
[size=4]
﻿﻿DO NOT REPORT IT TO POSTS TAB because it's harder to track ﻿than Bugs tab.
[/size][size=3]
﻿Before reporting, please check that you are using the latest version (it may be fixed), and that there are no similar reports.

[/size][size=4][What's new?]
If you want to know what's new in the latest updates, you can check it through the [url=https://github.com/Hackswell/GloryOfEfficiency/blob/develop/GloryOfEfficiency/WhatsNew.md]What's New file [/url]in the GitHub repository.[/size]
